collection.description: Watching birds build nests, a child wonders whether people are really so different from other animals.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Watching birds build nests, (child) wonders whether people are really so different from other animals.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) notices cooperation and learning among animals.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (elder) points out both similarities and meaningful differences without claiming humans are superior in every way.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) invents a complicated new word for friendship.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The discussion becomes a debate about whether animals communicate in ways people overlook.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The story gives (child) a sense of belonging.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) asks which parts are history and which are symbolism.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) seems relieved that adults do not know everything.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) decides to ask a different person tomorrow.
